game: Tom Clancy's Splinter Cell: Double Agent
approach: Android (ARM64 and x86_64) port of the TGP482 static recompilation; Vulkan renderer, on-device compilation from your own ISO
notes: Release candidate 1.0.0-rc.1 (prerelease). Tested on Adreno 710 (Android 16) and experimentally on Mali-G51 (Android 10, driver-specific workaround); an x86_64 emulator boots to the menu. Other Mali drivers and 16-KiB page-size devices untested. Controller recommended; touch controls available. Campaign only. No game files included.
